# Constitution: Dispensing App

## Core Principles

### I. A dose is never guessed
Any value shown to a clinician is either read from the record or absent. The app
never interpolates, rounds up, or falls back to a default dose.

### II. Offline is the normal case
Ward tablets lose connectivity daily. Offline behaviour is the specified
behaviour, not a degraded mode discovered in production.

**Version**: 2.1.0 | **Ratified**: 2025-03-11 | **Last Amended**: 2026-02-04
